claims.text: The Garden has ... the Vaughan dam where you can have a canoe ride.

landmarks.notes: No source names the water body. OSM has one unnamed natural=water polygon (0.76 ha) inside the Botanical Gardens and it is visible in Sentinel-2; it is identified as the Vaughan Dam because it is the only open water in the gardens.

landmarks.name: University of Ghana Business School
landmarks.notes: Two facilities share the name. OSM and Overture (Meta) put the University of Ghana Business School beside the Balme Library (UGBS car park, OSM way 715027982). The UG Campus Map's 'Business School' point (5.6587 N, 0.1777 W) is 1.3 km away on the UGBS Graduate Campus east of the N4 (OSM way 797937346, Meta 'Graduate Business School Multipurpose Building'). Both are kept, as separate places.

landmarks.name: Consolidated Bank Ghana (near Night Market)
landmarks.notes: Owner: CBG occupies the west wing of the banking-square compound (labelled C); its door is on the south side.

landmarks.name: UMB
landmarks.notes: Owner: the bank next to CBG in the compound's south wing (labelled F) is UMB (the owner first named it First Bank Ghana and corrected it); owner photo of its front: cream walls, white pillars, a dark gable with the yellow umb logo.

landmarks.name: Stanbic Bank
landmarks.notes: Owner: Stanbic occupies the north-east corner and the north half of the east wing (labelled S).

landmarks.name: Union Building (Banking Square)
landmarks.notes: Owner: the star-shaped single-storey building east of the compound is the Union Building and houses Ecobank; its sign reads ALUMNI BUILDING (owner photo).

landmarks.name: Diaspora Dome
landmarks.notes: Owner: the Diaspora Dome, across the road north-west of the Lizalex Quadrangle (between Alexander Kwapong and Elizabeth Sey halls): single-storey white marquee halls round a lawn with a round plaza. Placed from the owner's labelled map and aerial (the halls are identical, so the aerial is tied to Kwapong, the hall the map shows beside it).

landmarks.name: Standard Chartered ATM (near SRC Union Building)
landmarks.notes: Owner: the small one-floor building between the CC and the SRC Union Building houses Standard Chartered's ATMs.

landmarks.name: Supermart (Night Market)
landmarks.notes: Owner: the one-floor supermarket on the east side of the Night Market (circled black on the owner's aerial).
